name: seongho-ops
description: Guides design, debugging, verification, TDD, and measured performance work; routes operational CLIs; opens protected previews; and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility.

interface.shortDescription: Guide design, debugging, verification, TDD, and measured performance work; route operational CLIs; open previews; and provide k.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops provides lightweight, implicitly invocable brainstorming, systematic debugging, completion verification, test-driven development, and performance engineering skills. It also selects the correct authenticated local CLI for operational work, securely opens protected Vercel previews in the Codex browser, and bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports.
defaultPrompt: Use the correct local CLI for this operational task.
Diagnose this CLI authentication failure safely.
Open this protected Vercel preview in the Codex browser.
Free this local port with the bundled k command.
Verify this work before reporting completion.
Debug this failure from evidence before proposing a fix.
Implement this code change with test-driven development.
Measure this bottleneck and meet its performance target without guessing.
